title: Inside an AhsayCBS Intrusion: Hidden Webshells, a CryptoMiner, and a C2 Implant

title: Trusted by Default: Qubole Cross-Account Access Abused in the Wild
content: A threat actor exploited IAM credentials from Qubole's AWS account (805246085872) to assume integration roles in customer environments between October 14 and October 26, 2026. The attacker used two IAM users and multiple VPN addresses to gain access, then conducted extensive reconnaissance across affected AWS accounts. title: On the hunt for ARTEX: understanding agentic attacks in AWS environments

ARTEX operates through LLM agents that autonomously plan and execute attacks based on operator-defined objectives. title: Infostealer VOLTA That Has AI Assess Stolen Information
content: VOLTA is a Windows-based infostealer that incorporates an LLM assessment phase to evaluate stolen data.
